Supplementary materials and data:
- Create site metadata - consistent use of this
- Latitude and longitude for each site
- PFT for each site
- Climate for each site
- Mean annual precip
- Mean annual temp
- Maximum LAI across all years

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(ggrepel)

# Site Metadata - fill in lat/lon values here

site_meta <- tibble(
  site      = c("How", "Das", "Dap", "Dry", "Stp", "Asm", "Cum", "Emr",
                "Fog", "Gin", "Gww", "Rdf", "Rig", "Wac", "Whr", "Wom",
                "Ync", "Cpr", "Tum", "Rob", "Ade", "Boy"),
  lat       = c(-12.4943, -14.1593, -14.0633, -15.2588, -17.1507, -22.2830, -33.6152, -23.8587, -12.5452,  -31.3764, -30.1913, -14.5636, -36.6499, -37.4259, -36.6732, -37.4222, -34.9893, -34.0021, -35.6566, -17.1175, -13.0769, -32.4771),
  lon       = c(131.1523, 131.3881, 131.3181, 132.3706, 133.3502, 133.2490, 150.7236, 148.4746, 131.3072, 115.7138, 120.6541, 132.4776, 145.5759, 145.1878, 145.0294, 144.0944, 146.2907, 140.5891, 148.1517, 145.6301, 131.1178, 116.9386)
)

PFT              = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
                       NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
                       NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA),
  koppen           = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
                       NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
                       NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA),
  rainfall_season  = c(NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
                       NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA,
                       NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA)

# Map

australia <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", country = "Australia", returnclass = "sf")

sites_sf <- site_meta %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = australia, fill = "grey95", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_sf(data = sites_sf, colour = "firebrick", size = 2.5) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = site_meta,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = site),
    size = 3,
    segment.colour = "grey40",
    segment.size = 0.4,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    max.overlaps = Inf        # forces all labels to be drawn
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(110, 155), ylim = c(-45, -10)) +
  labs(
    title = "OzFlux study sites",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
